blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. will host Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva for a state visit on Nov. 14-15, marking the first visit to the Philippines by a sitting Brazilian president. The historic visit, announced by the Presidential Communications Office (PCO) on Tuesday, Nov. 10, comes ahead of the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit, which the Philippines will host as chair. It also coincides with the 80th anniversary of diplomatic relations between the Philippines and Brazil in 2026.
